row: Alicia Pet Care Center is a full service, family owned veterinary hospital that has been providing medical, surgical, and dental services for dogs and cats for over 50 years.  We have 9 awesome veterinarians, Dr Matthew Wheaton,  Dr. Lara Ashbran, Dr. Melissa Rellinger, Dr. Camille Coffey, Dr. Jennifer Burpo, Dr. Cortney Benson, Dr. Nathan Fynaardt, Dr. Matthew Vogel, and Dr. Callie Wilcox and a fun and friendly health care team to help take care of your babies!
